text: dsh-panel-fold 是 DSH 网页客户端插件，把侧边栏全局面板的图标入口折叠进现有的「更多」菜单，为工作区和会话列表留出空间。它通过客户端补丁标记面板列表，并隐藏除末尾「更多」按钮以外的行；同时在菜单中提供即时开关，可恢复图标显示，折叠状态默认开启并可记住。适合希望缩短侧栏面板区、保留面板访问入口的 DSH 网页用户。插件不需要 API 密钥、账号或额外外部服务。

dsh-panel-fold is a DSH web plugin that folds sidebar panels into More, freeing room for workspaces and sessions. It hides panel rows except More and adds a toggle that remembers the folded state. For users who want a shorter sidebar with panel access. No key or external service needed.
DSH 网页侧栏的全局面板图标太占地方，能收进更多菜单吗？
想给工作区和会话列表腾出侧栏空间，同时还保留面板入口。
Can I collapse the global panel shortcuts in the DSH web sidebar and still open them from More?
dsh-panel-fold 的功能「折叠全局面板入口」：网页侧栏只显示原有的「更多」按钮，将面板图标收进其菜单。安装后默认折叠；从菜单开关可即时展开或再次折叠。

[中文说明](#中文) · MIT · a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) web client plugin

dsh-panel-fold README · dsh-panel-fold：DSH's left sidebar devotes a fixed block near the top to the *global panel* launchers — Plugins, Automated tasks, XD Pool, Context insights, MCP connectors, WSL, Library, and so on. Every plugin that registers a panel adds one more 36px row there. With a handful of plugins installed, that block alone eats seven or eight rows, and the workspace / session list underneath gets squeezed into a narrow strip.

dsh-panel-fold README · dsh-panel-fold：This plugin folds those rows into the single **More** button that already sits at the bottom of that block. Panels stay one click away; the list above your sessions does not.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

Both screenshots are of the same window with the same plugins enabled — the only difference is the fold.

> Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (desktop profile, Windows). The fold survives `Ctrl+R`, and folded-vs-expanded round-trips in place without a reload.

dsh-panel-fold README · What you get：- **One row instead of eight.** The panel block collapses to `⋯ More`. The workspace list directly below gains roughly `7 × 36px` of height.
- **Nothing becomes unreachable.** Every panel is still in the More menu, and opening one behaves exactly as before (`selectPanel`, current selection preserved). `plugins` is untouched by design — it is the row ui-sidebar itself refuses to unpin.
- **A one-line toggle.** The last row of the More menu is `Show global panel icons` / `Fold global panel icons into More`. Click it and the rows come straight back, no reload, no restart.
- **The choice sticks.** Stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-panel-fold:mode` (`collapsed` | `expanded`), so it survives refresh, restart, and plugin reload.
- **Folded by default.** Installing the plugin is the opt-in.

dsh-panel-fold README · Install：Not on npm yet — install straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:meihuaanying/dsh-panel-fold
```

Or from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-panel-fold
```

Then reload the web client. The fold applies immediately; the toggle appears under the sidebar's More menu.

dsh-panel-fold README · Install：> Already installed an older copy under a different name? Remove it first (`dsh plugin --profile

remove `) so the profile does not keep a dangling link to a renamed folder.

dsh-panel-fold README · How it works：No patching of ui-sidebar, and no dependency on its hashed CSS class names (those change between releases):

1. The web client half watches the DOM with a `MutationObserver` and marks the panel-list `<nav>` — matched first by its `aria-label` (`全局面板` / `Global panels`, i.e. ui-sidebar's `t("panels.label")`), falling back to the structural signal *"a `<nav>` that contains a `button[aria-haspopup="menu"]` and at least two direct child buttons"*.
2. One CSS rule hangs off a class on `<html>`:

dsh-panel-fold README · Why not the built-in unpin mechanism?：ui-sidebar does have a "pin / unpin panel" mechanism (`setPinned`), and unpinning a panel removes its row while keeping it in the More menu. But `setPinned` is only reachable through the `sidebar.panellist.actions` owner props, and that slot only mounts *while the More menu is open* — there is no way to apply a pin state at startup. The CSS route needs no such hook, and it is what lets the plugin honour a persisted preference on first paint.

text:
dsh-panel-fold README · Reversibility：- **Temporary:** sidebar `More` → `Show global panel icons`. Instant.
- **Permanent:** disable or uninstall `dsh-panel-fold`. The `<style>` tag and the `<html>` class go with it, leaving the sidebar exactly as shipped.
- **Disable without uninstalling:** append to your user patch layer:

```yaml
  - id: dsh-panel-fold
    disabled: true
  ```

dsh-panel-fold README · Files：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/client.js` | The whole feature: style injection, `<nav>` marking, More-menu toggle row |
| `lib/index.js` | Host-side stub, exists only to carry the bundle patch row |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `dsh-panel-fold` row |
| `test/manifest.test.mjs` | Checks the manifest, patch, and client entry agree |
dsh-panel-fold README · Related work：Two other plugins touch the same block. Both are stable, MIT, and worth a look if you want more than a fold:

dsh-panel-fold README · Related work：- [`ACGsu/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold`](https://github.com/ACGsu/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold) — **the closest neighbour.** It adds its own "collapse panels" row above the list; collapsing turns the whole block into a single summary row (active panel icon + name) that opens a popover listing every panel, and the state persists through DSH's host settings channel rather than `localStorage`. If you would rather have a dedicated summary row with the active panel's name on it, use that one.
- [`LoktLin/dsh-sidebar-tidy`](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-sidebar-tidy) — a much broader take: it hides the brand row, the new-session button, the panel block *and* the footer settings behind one "exit minimal mode" button, and adds workspace colour blocks. If you want the whole sidebar stripped down, use that.

dsh-panel-fold README · Related work：`dsh-panel-fold` deliberately takes the smallest possible slice: it adds **no new row** — it reuses the More button ui-sidebar already renders at the bottom of the block — it changes nothing else in the sidebar, and it keeps the client half under 7 KB with no host-side code at all.

dsh-panel-fold README · 中文：**把左侧栏那排「全局面板」图标收进『更多』，把纵向空间还给工作区和会话列表。**

DSH 左侧栏顶部有一块固定的「全局面板」入口区 —— 插件、自动化任务、XD Pool、上下文洞察、MCP 连接器、WSL、资料馆……每装一个会注册面板的插件，这里就多一行 36px。装上几个插件后，这块自己能占七八行，下面的工作区 / 会话列表被挤成窄窄一条。

这个插件把那一排收进块底本来就有的 **『更多』** 按钮里。面板仍然一键可达，你的会话列表回来了。

dsh-panel-fold README · 你会得到：- **一行代替八行。** 面板块收成一个 `⋯ 更多`，下面的工作区列表多出约 `7 × 36px`。
- **没有任何东西变得不可达。** 所有面板都在『更多』菜单里，点开行为完全不变（`selectPanel`，当前选中项保留）。`plugins` 一行按设计不动 —— ui-sidebar 自己就不允许取消固定它。
- **一行开关。** 『更多』菜单最后一行是「显示全局面板图标 / 收起全局面板图标（只留『更多』）」，点一下立刻来回切，不用刷新、不用重启。
- **选择会被记住。** 存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-panel-fold:mode`（`collapsed` | `expanded`），刷新、重启、插件重载都保持。
- **默认折叠。** 装上它本身就是你的选择。

dsh-panel-fold README · 安装：还没上 npm，直接从 GitHub 装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:meihuaanying/dsh-panel-fold ``` 本地目录安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add /path/to/dsh-panel-fold ``` 然后刷新 web 客户端。折叠立即生效，开关在侧栏『更多』菜单里。 > 之前装过改名前的老版本？先 `dsh plugin --profile

remove <旧包名>`，否则 profile 会留下指向已改名目录的断链。

dsh-panel-fold README · 实现方式：那个 `<nav>` 的最后一个子元素就是『更多』按钮，所以只剩它。
3. 开关行注册进 `sidebar.panellist.actions` 槽，ui-sidebar 会把它渲染在『更多』菜单里。

dsh-panel-fold README · 为什么不用内置的「取消固定」？：ui-sidebar 确实有「固定 / 取消固定面板」机制（`setPinned`），取消固定后面板行会从边栏消失、但仍留在『更多』菜单里。但 `setPinned` 只能通过 `sidebar.panellist.actions` 的 owner props 拿到，而那个槽**只在『更多』菜单展开时挂载** —— 启动时没有任何钩子能应用一个固定状态。CSS 路线不需要这个钩子，这也是它能首帧就兑现已保存偏好的原因。
section: 为什么不用内置的「取消固定」？

text:
dsh-panel-fold README · 恢复：- **临时**：侧栏『更多』→「显示全局面板图标」。立刻生效。
- **彻底**：停用或卸载 `dsh-panel-fold`。`<style>` 标签和 `<html>` 上的类一起消失，侧边栏回到出厂样子。
- **只停用不卸载**：在自己补丁层追加

```yaml
  - id: dsh-panel-fold
    disabled: true
  ```

dsh-panel-fold README · 与类似项目的关系：还有两个插件动的是同一块，都是 MIT、都在维护，想多要一点就看它们：

- [`ACGsu/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold`](https://github.com/ACGsu/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold) —— **最接近的一个。** 它在面板列表上方**自己加一行**「收起面板」；收起后整块变成一行摘要（当前面板图标 + 名字），点这一行弹浮层列出全部面板；状态存在 DSH 的 Host 设置通道里而不是 `localStorage`。你想要「一行摘要 + 当前面板名」那种形态，用那个。
- [`LoktLin/dsh-sidebar-tidy`](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-sidebar-tidy) —— 更激进：把品牌行、新会话按钮、面板块、底部设置全部收进一个「退出极简」按钮，还给工作区加彩色缩写块。你要的是「整个侧栏极简」，用那个。
dsh-panel-fold README · 与类似项目的关系：`dsh-panel-fold` 刻意只切最小的那一块：**不新增任何一行**（复用 ui-sidebar 本来就在块底渲染的『更多』按钮），侧栏其它地方一律不动，客户端半边不到 7 KB、完全没有 Host 侧代码。
